notes: EXTERIOR BAY, OPEN TO SKY: the room box is a 16 x 26 m slice of wooded hillside; h = 11 m is empty air, no ceiling or canopy geometry is authored, and nothing closes the top of the volume. The camera side is z = 0 (upslope, just behind the standing position); the far end opens onto the lake. Read off plate.png: the flagstone trail runs down the middle on a gentle left-hand curve, three paved runs (near centred x +1.3, mid x +0.4, far x -0.7) joined by two sunk slab steps at z 9.1 and z 18.6. LEFT: a steep earthen bank rises about 2 m and carries eight heavy old pines (diameters 0.55-0.70 m, centres at y 6.0 so they grow out of the slope); its base is strewn with granite boulder clusters, a lone round boulder, a lifted root plate, two silvered deadfall logs and two sawn stumps. RIGHT: a dense even-aged stand of sixteen slim pines (0.30-0.44 m) spaced 1.2-2 m apart from z 1.6 to z 24 on a low mossy shoulder, with a second deadfall among them. FAR: the stand thins, the ground drops away, and a bright water slab with a low dark opposite-shore slab closes the view, framed by two heavier pines at x -2.3 and x 7.3; a leaning mooring post marks the margin at z 23.6, and the sight-line from the camera position threads the gap between the right-hand stand and the left framing pine straight onto the water. Depth massing measures roughly 34% near, 28% middle, 38% far - all well over the 12% floor, with the near bank, shoulder and first pines giving the foreground weight a photographer would want. 37 of 53 props are archetypes (26 columns, 6 stacks, 5 clutter); the largest plain box is the mid bank at 64.7 cubic metres, under the 68.6 cubic metre (1.5% of room volume) cap. Nothing emits light; all illumination is the overcast sky described in look.
look: Colour photograph, a wooded lakeside trail on a dim grey morning. Red-brown pine bark rough and fissured, granite flags damp-rimmed with moss, packed earth the colour of wet umber, fallen needles rusting to cinnamon, lichen blotching the stones, spider silk beaded with moisture, everything quietly damp. Overcast white sky showing through thinning canopy: cold diffuse daylight with no direct sun, falling evenly through the pines and fading downhill, the lake beyond reading as a flat bright pewter glare, distance dissolving into pale mist, shadow pooling blue-grey beneath the dense stand, no highlight anywhere brighter than the sky itself. Available-light photograph, sharp focus throughout, fine surface detail, subdued desaturated colour, muted russets and grey-greens.
